release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.6 Release:
• Double Live-End Cutting Length: Tendons with 2 live stressing ends (LIVE -> LIVE) now correctly double the cutting length allowance (e.g., 2 x 0.30 m = 0.60 m) across all DXF tables, Excel schedules, CSV exports, and viewport summaries.
• UI Stability & Feature Gating: Rebar Detailing View is safely isolated behind a development feature flag, preserving full core stability for this release.
• 3D Clash Detection & Cover Verification: Automatic 3D duct penetration detection and local-datum concrete cover checks.
• Performance & CAD Engine: Multi-core and GPU acceleration updates with rounded corner styling and improved cross-section framing.
